project_name: IELTS Academic & General Training Exam Preparation Platform
design_archetype: Swiss & High-Contrast mixed with Academic Trust & Precision
theme: Light theme primary for exam focus & high contrast readability, with deep dark navy structural headers and high-density dashboard layouts.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E2E8F0 with crisp sharp or subtle 6px rounded edges
visual_enhancers.card_style: Cardless or clean white panel with 1px border stroke, zero heavy gradients
visual_enhancers.texture: Subtle noise background accent on hero sections, crisp line separators for split-screen exam mode

header.low_time_alert: Blinks red when remaining time < 5 minutes

exam_interface_specs.reading_layout: Split screen: left passage scrollable (50% width), right questions (50% width)
exam_interface_specs.listening_layout: Top audio player with waveform & timestamp + right question cards with progress tracker
exam_interface_specs.writing_layout: Left task prompt & instructions (40% width), right clean editor with auto word-count & character counter (60% width)
exam_interface_specs.speaking_layout: Mic diagnostic check wizard, audio wave activity meter, timer countdown, auto recording player
exam_interface_specs.bottom_nav_bar: Sticky bottom strip containing question buttons 1-40 with dual-indicator state (color + icon/underline) for accessibility

hero_student_library.description: Student working on laptop in modern quiet library

student_collaborative.description: Diverse group of students preparing for IELTS exam

accessibility.contrast_ratio: APCA compliant minimum 4.5:1 for normal text
accessibility.question_navigation_states: Answered uses solid bg + check icon; Flagged uses yellow bg + flag icon; Never color alone
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full tab index support during computer-delivered exam mode

instructions_to_main_agent: Use standard React .js and .jsx components matching existing codebase in /app/frontend/src/.

Ensure every single interactive element (buttons, tabs, inputs, exam navigation buttons, band score badges, menu items, table rows) includes a clear data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='start-mock-test-button').

Implement distinct pages and routes for Public Website (Home, Academic, General Training, Prep modules, Free Mock Test, Pricing, Courses/Batches, Success Stories, FAQ, Login, Register), Student Dashboard (Overview, Practice Center, Mock Exam Hub, Band Score Analytics, AI Evaluation Reports, Subscription), and Admin Dashboard (Students, Batches, Teachers, Exam Builder, Question Bank, AI Settings, Financial Reports).

For the computer-based IELTS Exam Interface, build true-to-life split-screen layouts for Reading, Listening, Writing, and Speaking with sticky top header timer, font size adjustment controls, volume control, question navigator bar at the bottom with 1-40 question pills, answered/flagged badges, live word count for writing, and audio recording controls for speaking.

Include Band Score Indicator components displaying sub-scores (0-9 with 0.5 step accuracy) and overall Band scores with detailed criteria radar/bar breakdown (Fluency, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range, Coherence).
Keep styling crisp, academic, highly structured, and clean. DO NOT add excessive gradients, glassmorphism blur overload, or generic SaaS marketing slop.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts or unstyled default HTML select/inputs. Use customizable Shadcn components from /app/frontend/src/components/ui/.
Avoid using transparent background headers without backdrop blur or solid fill.
Always set hover text color explicitly alongside hover background color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
Maintain high spacing hierarchy using p-6 to p-12 for dashboard panels and hero sections.
Verify dark and light mode variable compatibility in tailwind.config.js and index.css.
